customerOutcome: Reconcile one original installation request without creating a second setup or inferring activation from an acknowledgement.
entryConditions: Current company and original current Human session, including explicit Native local operator policy.
Current verified member/Original installing principal and Agent read authority on the server; instance-admin claims are not a substitute.
A matching retained per-tab locator or exact request UUID. Restoring a locator never reconstructs configuration or dispatches a POST.
exitConditions: Clear only the matching local pending locator after the Original reader confirms its record; return to existing package controls.
Leave for Home while retaining unresolved identity. Pending, failed or missing observations remain unconfirmed.

content.supportingCopy: Recorded current installation state is separate from proof of a running Agent or verified business result.
displayedState: Only current installation status/version and Original observation time; no names, component pins, reasons or result bodies.
Waiting for the original transport, current read checking, unconfirmed, denied/unavailable and recorded current state are distinct.
A missing record is not proof that the first request failed.

primary.label: Return to packages
primary.operation: Clear the matching per-tab locator only after a current Original read confirms the record, then navigate. No server mutation.

secondary: Check the Original request using a bounded private GET.
Leave for Home retaining the pending locator.
Only the still-open form can explicitly resend its exact captured input/request key through the existing Native installation owner; restored locators offer no resend.

canonicalReadDomains: Original package installation request binding and current metadata under company/creator/Agent read authority.
Original successful current session, privacy serialization and current membership; no copied response authorizes another reader.
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Optional explicit resend through Original installation POST, using the same retained request UUID and unchanged in-memory setup. Current Native access/admission/version/pin guards remain; no activation or permission grant. Reading creates no write.
systemWork.authorityEffect: Current requester and Agent read are required for metadata. New work retains the Native installation owner and rollout. Current-session epoch/mounted-reader fences reject late private responses.
systemWork.asyncWork: 1500 ms total Source/SQL budget and 250 ms lock budget on metadata; exact existing company/requester/request index, one share-locked row. No automatic resend, assessment or background repair.
systemWork.receipt: The immutable Original request binding identifies the current installation record. Its status is current configuration metadata, not immutable historical status or physical/verified outcome proof.

states.loading: Hide private fields and prior observations during session/Source checks. Awaiting the original response does not imply completion.
states.empty: There is no complete-empty success state: an absent Original record remains unconfirmed.
states.partial: Unknown acknowledgement or inaccessible Original state retains its request locator. Other maintenance/qualification is outside this view.
states.stale: Withdraw prior state/actions on account/Source epoch changes; a new Original read is required.
states.validation_error: Malformed or over-budget/corrupt locator storage refuses new work; no raw configuration is restored or shown.
states.system_error: Keep the original locator and fixed unconfirmed copy; never display provider/error prose or create a new request key automatically.
states.permission_denied: Current account/membership/Agent read refusal withholds all private record metadata and cannot clear it as a successful outcome.
states.recovering: Explicitly read the Original request. An optional unchanged resend requires the original open form and Native owner; it is never rebuilt from stored locators.
states.success: Only the Original reader confirms a recorded binding; show current status separately from activation/running/verified business state.

navigation.back: Home; keep pending identity when the original outcome is unresolved.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: No raw form/input/result persistence; per-tab metadata only.
navigation.resume: Read exact company/principal/request locator through the Original owner, including after agent_packages_v7 closes. No new-work fallback or inferred failure.

accessibility.initialFocus: Receipt H1 on entry unless a Native dialog owns focus.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Named unconfirmed/error status and explicit current-read action; preserve native dialog focus.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Keep H1 and user focus while current state appears; do not announce activation.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard links/buttons; no custom keyboard trap.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Polite loading/waiting; alert for unconfirmed/unavailable; recorded state has a named section.
accessibility.targetSize: New controls use token min-h-11 targets.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Stacked metadata and wrapping secondary actions; cancel/return in one footer row. Browser 390px/automated checks do not qualify manual 200/400% or assistive technology.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One main landmark belongs to Native Layout; this supporting view renders a section with H1 and current-state H2.

responsive.wide: Stacked minimal record and recovery controls.
responsive.narrow: Wrapping secondary actions; no data table.
responsive.mobile: Token touch targets and no horizontal overflow; actual EN/DA browser evidence remains separate.

dataShown: Current own installation status/version and observation time only.
dataCollected: Per-tab company UUID, original principal identifier and request UUID only; 32-entry/8 KiB bounds and strict closed parsing. Clear matching locator only after a confirmed read.
sensitiveFields: No setup, component, Agent/source name, credential, reason, private result or error body is stored in the recovery locator or returned by its reader.
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Private/no-store HTTP responses and existing normalized private package namespace, including refused methods. No generic raw body/query/error/identifier logs.

prohibitedPayloads: No request/configuration contents, actor identifiers, request IDs, sources, errors or metadata in analytics.

functional: Actual Native install/request binding survives release withdrawal, uninstall and rollout closure with no additional Activity or installation.
Exact query key and current company/creator/verified account/Agent read are enforced; absent stays unconfirmed.
Lost response retains one locator; reload performs GET only; an explicit in-memory resend reuses identical input/key.
A transport acknowledgement alone never clears pending identity: the Original reader must confirm its record.
accessibility: One main, initial H1, token targets, clear unknown/recorded semantics and mobile reflow; manual assistive technology remains pending.
securityPrivacy: Strict metadata DTO, foreign/expanded response rejection, private headers/logging, unknown/corrupt-storage refusal and current-session/late-reader withdrawal.
Restored locators cannot supply a body or new authority; Source/permission loss never becomes an accepted outcome.
usability: Recorded configuration is separate from activation/running/business proof; reference EN/DA fixed copy.
Real Human/host/provider qualification remains pending; controlled transport fixtures are software evidence only.
